svg.text: Architecture & demo flow / Existing assessment design
Separate process • ingest once, reuse at query time
Persistent source volume: original PDFs + ingestion manifests
Failed ingestion keeps the last working corpus available.
Unsupported claims → repair once or abstain
Embeddings • Routing • Planning • Answer generation • Support check | Timeouts, token budgets, capped retries
